decision.research_semantics: Declare a fresh prospective structural law before evaluation. Do not reuse or reparameterize the Epoch26 diagnostic, tune from observed outcomes, select a subgroup retrospectively, or authorize an economic outcome. Treat the Epoch34 composite result as historical context, not prospective input.
decision.scope: All 41 current structural representatives with accepted 13-week M5 history, as bound by the current frontier and Epoch25 selection authority; representatives are not economic equivalents.

constraints: Predeclare a genuinely distinct law; do not rerun or redesign the Epoch26 diagnostic using its observed result.
Keep the evaluation non-economic and prospective.
Do not close the mechanism family or promote any symbol based on this selection.

scope.breadth_basis: Use the full accepted current representative set to retain peer-ranking information across distinct structural signatures.

objective.goal: Select a fresh, prospective cross-sectional ranking study across the current broker-native structural representatives.
objective.information_gain_rationale: This family can test whether contemporaneous cross-symbol ordering contains a repeatable structural signal. Using the full currently accepted representative set preserves cross-sectional breadth and structural heterogeneity; no new market data is indicated as necessary.
